concerns.text: FR-009 mandates VIF diagnostics on *all* predictor variables, including the atom‑type count features (FR‑021). These atom‑type counts are derived directly from the atomic composition of each crystal, which is also the basis for the numerator of the Packing Coefficient defined in FR‑003 (sum of atomic van der Waals volumes). Because the target PC is a deterministic function of the same atom‑type information, the predictor matrix contains variables that are not independent of the outcome. This creates a circular/tautological validation: the model can exploit features that are essentially part of the target definition, violating the requirement that validation targets be independent of predictors.
